honest_findings.primary_conclusion: Overlay (AR + M4) coupling on C_softmax baseline does NOT produce strict-dominant risk-adjusted enhancement. All 3 coupling specs reduce SR (-0.026 ~ -0.057) while modestly improving MDD (+2.04 ~ +3.89pp). Best risk-adjusted profile: C2 (min) — Calmar +0.0064 (marginal positive only).
honest_findings.structural_explanation: C_softmax 4-sleeve baseline already incorporates crisis hedging via 45% non-KR-equity allocation (TSMOM + KR_10y + Cash). Overlay on KR equity sleeve creates redundancy with sleeve diversification. STR_1715 (single-sleeve top20 long_only) case where AR+M4 strict-dominated does NOT transfer to multi-sleeve composite.
implications_for_pg2_enhancement_path: Overlay integration on current sleeve allocation (KR equity 55%) is NOT a clear path to PG2 enhancement.

Alternative paths emerge for forge/optimizer cycle: (a) higher KR equity sleeve weight where overlay marginal benefit increases; (b) overlay on TSMOM or KR_10y sleeve separately (uncorrelated risk); (c) alternative coupling (AR triggers TSMOM allocation increase, not KR equity reduction); (d) regime-conditional sleeve weights (AR/m4 → dynamic sleeve allocation instead of scalar KR equity overlay).
